scope: Application Launcher logo and desktop integration

behaviors.contract: The main Wayland application ID, desktop file basename and theme icon name are applicationlauncher. The desktop entry launches the existing command without changing activation behavior.
behaviors.manual: Install the desktop entry and SVG as user XDG application and hicolor icon symlinks; refresh the desktop database; import the bundled KWin rule after existing user rules and reconfigure KWin. Confirm launcher and subwindow icons without changing unique native focus identities.

behaviors.contract: Every launcher-owned native viewport carries the same valid, cached 128px RGBA logo and a launcher-family app ID. Existing root and unique info foreground identities are preserved. Native icon pixels are used on supporting platforms; KDE Wayland uses the desktop-file rule instead.

The KWin rule changes only desktop identity for the exact main and PID/viewport-specific launcher app-ID family; unrelated applications and native window classes, focus and geometry are unaffected. Existing user rule order is preserved during installation.
behaviors.manual: Check the installed rule is appended after existing user rules, its fields match the bundled rule, the desktop entry/icon resolve, and KWin reconfiguration succeeds without restarting applications.
